'''Ossberry ale''' was a type of [[Ale/Legends|ale]] that had a [[Blue|bluish]] color. [[Darth Caedus|Jacen Solo]], and his sister [[Jaina Solo Fel|Jaina Solo]] drank some Ossbery Ale while they were on the [[Starship/Legends|ship]] ''[[Tradewyn]]''. They were having a meal with [[Aryn Dro Thul]], her son [[Raynar Thul|Raynar]], and Raynar's uncle [[Tyko Thul]] while discussing the disappearance of Raynar's father, [[Bornan Thul|Bornan]].
